title: Divine Sense
text:
Divine Sense reveals nearby spiritual plants and spirit stone ore through obstacles.


Detection radius and the shared highlight limit grow with cultivation; major realm breakthroughs grant much larger gains.


Plants appear as small three-dimensional crosses with two-pixel-wide lines.


The hue follows their element: Fire red, Earth orange, Wood dark green, Wind bright green, Water blue, Ice cyan and Lightning yellow. Neutral plants remain white.


At zero spiritual growth, the cross is pure white. Color strengthens quickly at low spiritual growth, then increases more gradually as growth rises, reaching the full element color at the maximum growth of 9,999.


This shows the plant's growth, not its Qi-source reserve. Spirit stone ore keeps its block outline.


The skill stats show radius and highlight limit.


Highlights reach their strongest opacity three blocks inside detection range and fade at very close distances to keep dense gardens and ore deposits readable.
